component.name: json-validator
component.title: JSON Schema Validator
component.description: Validate the JSON in the message body or in a header against a JSON Schema, with the NetworkNT JSON Schema Validator.
component.label: validation

contentCache.description: The contentCache value that the component sets on each endpoint that it creates. The endpoint loads the schema on the first message and keeps it, whatever this value is. The JMX operation clearContentCache makes the endpoint load the schema again on the next message.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

useDefaultObjectMapper.description: Whether the endpoints use the Jackson 3 (tools.jackson) ObjectMapper of the registry to parse the JSON to validate, when the registry holds exactly one. The objectMapper option takes precedence. If no mapper is found, the endpoint creates one with the Jackson 2 defaults.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

objectMapper.label: advanced
objectMapper.description: The id of a Jackson 3 (tools.jackson) ObjectMapper in the registry that the endpoints use to parse the JSON to validate. Takes precedence over useDefaultObjectMapper. Creating an endpoint fails when the registry has no ObjectMapper with this id.

producerIn.description: The JSON to validate: text, bytes, a stream or a file. A Map, a POJO or no body fails: marshal it first; with headerName the header is validated instead

producerOut.description: Unchanged: JSON that does not match the schema, or text that is not JSON, fails with a JsonValidationException

resourceUri.description: Path to the resource. You can prefix with: classpath, file, http, ref, or bean. classpath, file and http loads the resource using these protocols (classpath is default). ref will lookup the resource in the registry. bean will call a method on a bean to be used as the resource. For bean you can specify the method name after dot, eg bean:myBean.myMethod.

allowContextMapAll.description: Sets whether the context map should allow access to all details. By default only the message body and headers can be accessed. This option can be enabled for full access to the current Exchange and CamelContext. Doing so impose a potential security risk as this opens access to the full power of CamelContext API.

contentCache.description: Sets whether to use resource content cache or not

failOnNullBody.description: Whether to fail with a NoJsonBodyValidationException when the message has no body. If false, a message without a body is not validated and continues unchanged. Not used with headerName, where failOnNullHeader applies instead.

failOnNullHeader.description: Whether to fail with a NoJsonHeaderValidationException when the header of the headerName option is missing or null. If false, the message is then not validated and continues unchanged. Only used with headerName.

headerName.description: The name of the header that holds the JSON to validate, in place of the message body. If not set, the message body is validated.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

disabledDeserializationFeatures.label: advanced
disabledDeserializationFeatures.description: Comma-separated list of Jackson 3 DeserializationFeature names to disable on a copy of the ObjectMapper that parses the JSON to validate. An unknown name fails the start of the endpoint. The schema itself is parsed with a separate mapper.

enabledDeserializationFeatures.label: advanced
enabledDeserializationFeatures.description: Comma-separated list of Jackson 3 DeserializationFeature names, such as FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS, to enable on a copy of the ObjectMapper that parses the JSON to validate. An unknown name fails the start of the endpoint. The schema itself is parsed with a separate mapper.

errorHandler.label: advanced
errorHandler.description: A custom JsonValidatorErrorHandler that receives the schema validation errors, or the exception when the JSON cannot be read or parsed. The default handler throws a JsonValidationException. A handler that does not throw lets the message continue.

objectMapper.label: advanced
objectMapper.description: The Jackson 3 (tools.jackson) ObjectMapper that parses the JSON to validate. If not set, the objectMapper and useDefaultObjectMapper options of the component decide, and otherwise the endpoint creates a mapper with the Jackson 2 defaults.

uriSchemaLoader.label: advanced
uriSchemaLoader.description: A custom JsonUriSchemaLoader that creates the schema from the resourceUri, for example to add custom formats or keywords. The default loader takes the JSON Schema version from the $schema property of the schema, and uses draft 2019-09 when $schema is missing or unknown.
